title: The ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Merch Machine Strikes Again With Headphones, Speakers & More for Just $20 at Target
summary: It looks like a can of soda, but it's actually a speaker. Shop the creative and affordable KPop Demon Hunters tech online at Target.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Forget fighting demons. The real battle is resisting a shopping spree. Heyday is bringing KPop Demon Hunters fans a collection of affordable tech goodies to Target , including headphones, speakers, charging accessories, power banks and adorable lights. Inspired by Rumi, Mira, Zoey, HUNTR/X, the Saja Boys, Derpy and Sussie, each of the five initial product types costs just $20, making it easier to rep your favorite characters without draining your wallet. The collection arrived Oct. 11 at Target, both in stores and online, but the fun doesn’t stop there.

shop the full collection here

A second drop is scheduled for Nov. 8, bringing gaming and creator tech into the mix. Whether you’re powering up your phone, vibing to your favorite tracks or adding a little character to your nightstand, this collaboration makes practical tech feel a whole lot more playful.

SPEAKER

Saja Boys Speaker

Act Fast

$20

Buy Now at target

As of this writing, only four speakers remain, so get yours now while they’re still available.

The KPop Demon Hunters soda can speaker by Heyday is a fun, budget-friendly way to enjoy music without investing in expensive audio gear. Its eye-catching design makes it a standout choice for fans, while Bluetooth connectivity and up to four hours of playback make it practical for everyday use. Party Sync also lets you connect compatible speakers for a bigger listening experience.

HEADPHONES

Gold Headphones

Going Fast

As of this writing, only three of the gold headphones are available.

These on-ear headphones feature cushioned ear pads, a foldable design, and an inline microphone with volume controls. The 3.5 mm AUX connection works with compatible phones, tablets and laptops.

Rumi Headphones

Rumi fans can take their music obsession everywhere with these wired on-ear headphones. The foldable design makes them easy to stash in a backpack, while cushioned ear pads help keep listening comfortable. There’s also an in-line microphone for calls and a volume controller for quick adjustments. At $20, they’re a fun, budget-friendly pick for everyday listening.

Mira Headphones

Prefer headphones that cover your ears? Mira’s over-ear design offers a cozy alternative for listening to playlists, watching videos or taking calls. The standard 3.5 mm connection means no Bluetooth pairing or charging routine to worry about.

Zoey Headphones

Distinct in design from the Rumi and Mira headphones, but featuring the same tech specs, this pair comes in turquoise with Zoey’s signature on the inside.

LIGHT

Derpy Pat Pat Light

Derpy is ready to brighten up your desk or bedside table, and yes, the cuteness is part of the appeal. Its soft silicone body feels pleasant to touch, while tap controls let you switch between three brightness levels.

HUNTR/X Pat Pat Light

The HUNTR/X Pat Pat Light runs for up to six hours per charge and recharges using the included cable. At $20, it’s a functional piece of fan decor rather than just another collectible gathering dust.

Sussie Pat Pat Light

For fans who like their decor cute and useful, the Sussie Bird light checks both boxes.

CHARGER

Rumi Ramen Charging Bundle

This product may look like a cup of ramen and a set of chopsticks, just like HUNTR/X’s favorite post-show meal, but really, it’s a convenient charging station for fans who can’t get enough of the KPop Demon Hunters universe.

Mira Ramen Charging Bundle

The charging bundle includes a wall adapter delivering up to 20 watts and a generous six-foot USB-C cable, giving you more flexibility when outlets aren’t conveniently placed.

Zoey Ramen Charging Bundle

At $20, it’s a practical option if you need a replacement charger or want matching character-inspired accessories without buying everything separately.

POWER BANK

HUNTR/X Light-Up Power Bank

Keep your phone alive between playlists and fandom chats with this HUNTR/X-inspired power bank. Its 5,000 mAh battery offers portable backup power, while the USB-C port delivers up to 20 watts — these are all good things!

Saja Boys Light-Up Power Bank

The Saja Boys portable charger is made for fans who want to support the rival boy band/demon army.

The KPop Demon Hunters takeover shows no signs of slowing down, and the franchise’s merch machine is working overtime. From backpacks and tech accessories to toys and Halloween costumes , there’s seemingly no end to the ways fans can bring HUNTR/X home. Honestly, the demons might be easier to escape than the checkout button. With record-breaking popularity and a fandom that keeps growing, this franchise has turned a hit movie into a full-blown pop culture obsession.

The accolades are just as golden. The film scored two Oscars , while “Golden” snagged a Grammy , cementing its musical impact. An upcoming global concert tour promises to bring the fandom’s energy to live audiences, and a second movie is officially in development. Consider those light sticks permanently on standby.
